exposure.needed: whether external monitoring (Prometheus queries, dashboards, alerts) references the crossplane_composition_controllers_*, crossplane_composition_watches_* or crossplane_composition_run_function_* metric names

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, Crossplane exposes these metrics under the new names engine_controllers_*, engine_watches_* and function_run_function_* instead of the crossplane_composition_* names.
consequence.remediation: Change any Prometheus queries, dashboards or alerts that use crossplane_composition_controllers_*, crossplane_composition_watches_* or crossplane_composition_run_function_* to use the new metric names.

assertion.statement: In Crossplane 2.0.0, the Prometheus metrics for the controller engine and function response caches have new names: crossplane_composition_controllers_* is now engine_controllers_*, crossplane_composition_watches_* is now engine_watches_*, and crossplane_composition_run_function_* is now function_run_function_*.
